# Expression analysis {#sec-expression}

::: {.callout-note title="From the exam description"}
Expression analysis of genes and proteins: methods, algorithms, statistics.
:::

## Introduction

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Short introduction: measuring transcripts (microarrays → RNA-seq →
single-cell), from reads to counts, normalisation, differential expression,
clustering and dimensionality reduction, and the statistics of testing
thousands of genes at once.
:::

## Key concepts

- Microarrays: principle, normalisation, limitations
- RNA-seq workflow: library preparation, spliced alignment (STAR) vs. pseudo-alignment (kallisto, Salmon), transcript assembly
- Normalisation: library size, RPKM/FPKM/TPM, TMM, size factors
- Differential expression: count models (negative binomial), dispersion estimation, DESeq2, edgeR
- Multiple testing: Bonferroni/FWER, false discovery rate (Benjamini–Hochberg), q-values, empirical Bayes
- Clustering (hierarchical, k-means) and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)
- Gene set enrichment analysis
- Single-cell RNA-seq: sparsity, normalisation, clustering, cell-type annotation; spatial transcriptomics
- Protein-level expression (see @sec-proteomics); the Human Protein Atlas

- [RNA-Seq](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RNA-Seq)

## Key papers

::: {.callout-tip}
★ = mandatory in earlier reading lists.
:::

### Reviews — start here

- ★ @wang2009 — RNA-seq: a revolutionary tool for transcriptomics.
- @conesa2016 — a survey of best practices for RNA-seq data analysis.
- @stark2019 — RNA sequencing: the teenage years.
- @heumos2023 — best practices for single-cell analysis across modalities.
- @quackenbush2001 — computational analysis of microarray data.

### Microarrays

- @fodor1991 — light-directed parallel synthesis (the basis of Affymetrix arrays).
- @schena1995 — quantitative monitoring of expression with cDNA microarrays.
- @eisen1998 — cluster analysis and display of genome-wide expression.
- @su2004 — a gene atlas of mouse and human transcriptomes.

### RNA-seq methods

- @mortazavi2008 — mapping and quantifying mammalian transcriptomes by RNA-seq.
- @trapnell2010 — Cufflinks: transcript assembly and quantification.
- @oshlack2010 — from RNA-seq reads to differential expression.
- @robinson2010 — edgeR.
- @love2014 — DESeq2.
- @dobin2013 — STAR spliced aligner.
- @bray2016 — kallisto: near-optimal probabilistic quantification.
- @patro2017 — Salmon.
- @subramanian2005 — gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA).
- @luecken2019 — current best practices in single-cell RNA-seq analysis.

### Statistics

- ★ @benjamini1995 — controlling the false discovery rate.
- @storey2003 — statistical significance for genome-wide studies (q-values).
- @efron2002 — empirical Bayes methods and FDR for microarrays.
- @lever2017 — principal component analysis (Points of Significance).
